description: Second golden for screenReferenceFolders: how item.* bindings resolve, and a list block's items binding. Same rule as reference-folders-golden.json, plus item.* resolution. Each case is its own screen; fields of data.* come from the screen's source schemas.
rule: item.* on a list block: against the entries of the list field when items is data.X; otherwise against the fields of the block's own source, else the screen's source. item.* on a block that doesn't repeat over items: with those same source fields (the block's source, else the screen's). A list block's items binding (data.X) counts, with its sub-fields' references, like any other binding.

cases.name: list over a list field
cases.why: itemTitle comes before items (key order), and item.hero resolves against the rules entries: heroes, then items brings its sub-fields (items; heroes again). Against the screen's source (no 'hero' field) it would be items, heroes.

cases.name: list with its own source
cases.why: item.spotlight resolves against the block's source (map: heroes), not the screen's (mode: news).

cases.name: list without items or a source of its own
cases.why: item.spotlight falls back to the screen's source (mode: news).

cases.name: item.* on a block that doesn't repeat
cases.why: detail_header doesn't repeat over items; item.spotlight resolves with the source fields (the screen's: mode, news). Ignoring it would give none.
